value.rationale: The balanced coefficient vector is a complete global sharp extremizer in the classical p=1 four-point Hilbert-normalized problem. The exact p<1 cusp proves this entire symmetry class stops being even locally optimal, not just suboptimal by a small numerical amount. A unique asymmetry replaces it along the intrinsic two-pair orbit and is determined at every quasi-Banach exponent by a sharp scalar law. This is a meaningful boundary between convex transport and concave p-transport; no arbitrary parameter slice or unproved unrestricted classification is claimed.
